The Red Team Analyst supports MUFG Red Team operations by executing adversary‑emulation activities focused on AI‑enabled technologies. This role is designed for early‑career professionals with a computer science background and practical coding experience, enabling them to develop offensive security skills while contributing to risk reduction across the enterprise.
  
  
Under the direction of senior operators, the analyst participates in threat‑led assessments, AI security testing, and purple team exercises, helping identify how real‑world adversaries could exploit application logic, automation pipelines, and AI‑assisted capabilities.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
Adversary Emulation & Testing Support
  
  

* Participate in Red Team missions designed to simulate real‑world attacker behavior against MUFG applications and platforms.
* Execute assigned activities during:

+ adversary simulation and emulation (ASE)
+ assumed‑breach scenarios
+ purple team and control‑validation exercises

* Safely conduct testing activities aligned to approved scopes, deconfliction requirements, and operational guardrails.

AI & Automation Workflow Testing
  
  

* Support adversarial testing of AI‑enabled capabilities, including:

+ prompt injection and misuse scenarios
+ unintended data access or disclosure via AI tools
+ bypass of AI guardrails and safety controls

* Assist in assessing AI‑assisted developer tools, copilots, and automation platforms.
* Help evaluate how AI interacts with identity, permissions, APIs, and data sources.

Tooling & Research
  
  

* Research emerging attacker techniques targeting:

+ modern application stacks
+ CI/CD and developer tooling
+ AI/LLM systems

* Contribute to Red Team playbooks, test cases, and repeatable workflows.
* Support senior operators in engagement reporting and evidence collection.
* Participate in post‑engagement discussions with defensive and engineering teams.
* Develop and operationalize custom ML/LLM models for cybersecurity use cases
* Advance preventative, detective, and responsive security controls through applied AI innovation
* Evaluate emerging AI capabilities for cybersecurity and mature predictive, proactive threat response

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated experience through internships, co‑ops, academic projects, or personal work.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn adversarial thinking.
* Hands-on experience with agentic AI, LLMs, and custom ML model development
* Proficiency with open-source AI frameworks and tooling (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, SageMaker)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with:

+ REST APIs, OAuth/OIDC, JWT
+ CI/CD pipelines or DevOps tooling

* Hands‑on experience using or experimenting with AI/LLM tools or prompt‑driven workflows.
* Familiarity with enterprise cloud AI platforms (e.g., Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, or GCP Vertex AI)

The Rotational Intensive Specialized Experience (RISE) Program, which lasts 2 years and includes 4 six-month rotations, is designed specifically for highly talented engineers who are looking for exposure to and experience in different disciplines of engineering. Participants will be immersed in new product development (design engineering), quality, product testing, simulation and so much more. Each individuals’ rotations are tailored to fit their passion and skill sets along with current business needs. RISE engineers will not only gain a broad knowledge of our Research & Development functions but will also have the opportunity to attend additional leadership and personal development trainings, seminars, and product labs. The RISE Engineering program also offers exposure to senior leadership with end of rotation presentations, town halls and small group forums. Upon successful completion of the program, participants are eligible to apply to any open roles within Stryker.
  
  
**A development journey that’s tailored to you!**
The RISE Program is designed specifically for highly talented individuals who are looking for an accelerated career progression. Participants will benefit from:
  
  

* Networking with Senior Leadership
* Exposure to cutting edge technology
* Engineering mentorship
* Personal and professional development
* Gain broad perspective of R&D functions

All resulting in inspiring & fulfilling careers, enduring friendships, and accelerated career progression!
  
  
**Rotation Information**
As a program participant, graduates will experience 4 six-month rotations and be placed on one of the following teams for each rotation:
  
  

* Advanced Quality Engineering (AQE)

AQE plays a critical role in Stryker that partners with New Product Development (NPD) teams to ensure the overall quality of a manufactured product.
  
  

* New Product Development Operations (NPD OPS)

NPD Ops serves R&D with multiple functions. Participants can be placed within the Custom Test Equipment team where they will experience product testing and test equipment development, Finite Element Analysis (FEA) where they will be trained and will conduct FEA on products in development, or Experimental where they will learn about prototypes, mills, lathes and 3D printing.
  
  

* Interventional Spine (IVS)

Advancing interventional care from diagnosis to delivery, IVS provides surgeons with an extensive and innovative product portfolio for vertebral augmentation, vertebroplasty and radiofrequency ablation procedures, along with a diagnostic tool and decompression treatment advances for contained disc herniations. Participants will work within the design phase process researching, developing, and delivering new products to market as a design engineer.
  
  

* Neurosurgical (NS)

NS offers products for the specific needs of Neurosurgical (cranial), Spine and ENT (ear, nose, throat) physicians with a comprehensive suite of products developed for the precision required by these specialties. The product innovation is focused on improving our customers’ existing surgical procedures, while exploring new techniques to further advance the clinical outcomes of their patients. Participants will work within the design phase process researching, developing, and delivering new products to market as a design engineer.
  
  

* Orthopaedic Instruments (OI)

OI delivers innovative products and services for the Orthopaedic ecosystem. This team’s focus is on power tools used on upper and lower extremities, and participants will work within the design phase process researching, developing, and delivering new products to market as a design engineer.
  
  

* Product Engineering (PE)

PE works closely with products in the field and will conduct redesign projects based on issues seen in the field. Participants may also work with manufacturing engineers on manufacturing line issues as a design engineer.
  
  

* Surgical Technologies (ST)

ST delivers products that enable caregivers to provide a safer, simple experience for their patients. They utilize technology to enhance products and create safe solutions for everyone in the operating room. Participants will work within the design phase process researching, developing, and delivering new products to market as a design engineer.
